description_en: Gets the details of a specified instance
name: GetInstance

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 实例连接地址，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The port of the instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 实例连接端口，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The SID of the instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 实例Sid，可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: sid

DataLinkName.description_en: The name of the data link for the instance

DatabasePassword.description_en: The password that corresponds to the username

DatabaseUser.description_en: The username used to log on to the instance

DbaId.description_en: The ID of the database administrator (DBA) of the instance

DbaNickName.description_en: The nickname of the DBA of the instance

DdlOnline.description_en: Indicates whether lock-free schema change is enabled for the instance

EcsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance on which the database instance is deployed

EcsRegion.description_en: The region where the instance resides

EnvType.description_en:
The type of the environment to which the instance belongs. Valid values:

product: production environment

dev: development environment

pre: pre-release environment

test: test environment

sit: system integration testing (SIT) environment

uat: user acceptance testing (UAT) environment

pet: performance testing environment

stag: staging environment
EnvType.description_zh:
实例环境类型，返回值如下：

product：生产环境
dev：开发环境
pre：预发环境
test：测试环境
sit：SIT环境
uat：UAT环境
pet：压测环境
stag：STAG环境

ExportTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for exporting data from the instance. Unit: seconds

Host.description_en: The endpoint used to connect to the instance

OwnerIdList.description_en: The IDs of the instance owners

OwnerIds.description_en: The user IDs of the instance owners

items.description_en: The user ID of an instance owner

OwnerNameList.description_en: The nicknames of the instance owners

OwnerNames.description_en: The nicknames of the instance owners

items.description_en: The nickname of an instance owner

Port.description_en: The port used to connect to the instance

QueryTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for querying data in the instance. Unit: seconds

SafeRuleId.description_en: The ID of the security rule set for the instance

SellSitd.description_en:
Indicates whether sensitive data protection is enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled
SellSitd.description_zh:
敏感数据保护是否开启，取值：

true：开启

false：关闭
SellSitd.title_zh: 为true，敏感数据保护开启，否则未开启

Sid.description_en: The system ID (SID) of the instance

StandardGroup.description_en: The control mode of the instance
StandardGroup.description_zh: 实例对应的管控模式信息

GroupMode.description_en:
The control mode. Valid values:

COMMON: Security Collaboration

NONE_CONTROL: Flexible Management

STABLE: Stable Change
GroupMode.description_zh:
管控模式类型，返回值如下：
COMMON：安全协同模式
NONE_CONTROL：自由操作模式
STABLE：稳定变更模式

GroupName.description_en: The name of the security rule set that corresponds to the control mode
GroupName.description_zh: 管控模式对应的安全规则名称

State.description_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

NORMAL: The instance is running as normal.

DISABLE: The instance is disabled
State.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值如下：

NORMAL：正常使用
DISABLE：禁用

UseDsql.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-database query is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

0: disabled

1: enabled
UseDsql.description_zh:
实例是否开启跨库查询：

0：不开启
1：开启

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the instance belongs

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
